Landing.Hero.Title: Know how much is enough, and when you will get there.
Landing.Hero.Lead: {appName} turns your income, spending, and savings into one plan: a target for financial independence, and the age your savings can reach it.
Landing.Hero.Note: Free to use. No bank logins. Your figures are visible only to you.
Landing.Plan.Label: Projected net worth
Landing.Plan.Caption: Sample plan: spending {spending} a year gives an FI target of {target}. Starting with {start} and saving {monthly} a month at a {rate}% yearly return, net worth reaches that target at age {age}.
Landing.Mission.Title: How the plan works
Landing.Mission.Lead: Financial independence means your investments can pay for the life you live, so work becomes a choice. We want everyone to see their own path there, without handing over bank logins or paying for advice.
Landing.Rule.Target.Text: At this size, withdrawing about 4% a year covers your spending. Spend {spending} a year and your target is {target}.
Landing.Rule.Growth.Text: What you save each month and the return you assume set how fast your net worth grows. Try base, conservative, and aggressive rates side by side.
Landing.Rule.Age.Text: Your projection shows the age your net worth reaches the target. The Dashboard tracks how far along you are.
Landing.Tools.Title: Three tools build your plan
Landing.Feature.NetWorth.Title: Net Worth
Landing.Feature.NetWorth.Description: Enter your savings, income and spending. See your projection to retirement in base, conservative, and aggressive scenarios.
Landing.Feature.Budget.Title: Budget
Landing.Feature.Budget.Description: Split your monthly income across ten spending categories, so you know how much is left to save.
Landing.Feature.SavingsGoals.Title: Savings Goals
Landing.Feature.SavingsGoals.Description: Set a target for each goal and track how much you have saved toward it.
Landing.Feature.SpreadsheetAnalysis.Desc: Turn your budget spreadsheets into monthly income, expense, and category breakdowns.
Landing.Feature.InvestmentCalculator.Des: Model compound growth with your own contributions, return rate, and time horizon.
Landing.Feature.GoogleDrive.Title: Google Drive Integration
Landing.Feature.GoogleDrive.Description: Connect a Drive folder and keep your budget spreadsheets in sync for analysis.
Landing.Feature.AiAssistant.Title: AI Assistant
Landing.Feature.AiAssistant.Description: Ask questions about budgeting, saving, and investing in plain language.
Landing.Feature.FinanceNews.Title: Finance News
Landing.Feature.FinanceNews.Description: Catch up on market and personal finance headlines without leaving the app.
Landing.Feature.Community.Title: Community
Landing.Feature.Community.Description: Vote in polls and read stories from others working toward financial independence.
Landing.Steps.Title: Get your first plan in three steps
Landing.Steps.Account.Title: Create your account
Landing.Steps.Account.Text: Register with your email address and choose a password. No payment details are needed.
Landing.Steps.Numbers.Title: Add your numbers
Landing.Steps.Numbers.Text: Enter your savings, income, and spending, set a monthly budget, and add your savings goals.
Landing.Steps.Follow.Title: Follow your plan
Landing.Steps.Follow.Text: Your Dashboard shows your progress to your FI target and the age you are on track to reach it.
Landing.Privacy.Title: Your financial data stays yours
Landing.Privacy.OnlyYou: Every figure you enter is tied to your account and shown only to you.
Landing.Privacy.Drive: Google Drive is only accessed when you choose to connect a folder.
Landing.Privacy.NoBankLogins: No bank logins are needed. You decide exactly what to enter.
Landing.Closing.Title: Find your FI target today
Landing.Closing.Lead: Create a free account and see the age your plan reaches it.
About.Title: About
About.Heading: About {appName}
About.WhatItIs.Title: What it is
About.WhatItIs.Text: {appName} is a free web app for planning your path to financial independence. You enter your savings, income and spending, and it turns them into one plan: a target for financial independence and the age your savings can reach it.
About.Why.Title: Why it exists
About.Why.Text: Most people never work out how much is enough. Spreadsheets get abandoned, and many budgeting apps ask for your bank logins. {appName} keeps the plan simple, lets you decide exactly what to enter, and shows your figures only to you.
About.Who.Title: Who builds it
About.Who.Text: {appName} is a solo developer project: one person designs, builds and runs it.
About.Features.Title: Core features
About.Features.NetWorth.Name: Net Worth
About.Features.NetWorth.Text: enter your starting balance, income, spending and savings to project when you can reach financial independence.
About.Features.BudgetPlanner.Name: Budget Planner
About.Features.BudgetPlanner.Text: set a monthly budget by category.
About.Features.BudgetTracker.Name: Budget Tracker
About.Features.BudgetTracker.Text: record what you spend and compare it with your plan.
About.Features.SavingsGoals.Name: Savings Goals
About.Features.SavingsGoals.Text: set targets and follow your progress.
About.Features.Analysis.Name: Analysis
About.Features.Analysis.Text: explore your figures and spreadsheets with charts.
About.Features.Community.Name: Community
About.Features.Community.Text: share ideas and questions with other users.
